audience: print-on-demand sellers who fulfill orders through Gooten

useCases.title: Browse products and variants for a country
useCases.text: The AI lists catalog products by name or category, then the orderable variants (SKUs) with options and your price for a destination country.

useCases.title: Check stock and shipping cost for a destination
useCases.text: The AI checks which SKUs are out of stock for a destination, and gets shipping price, options and delivery days for a cart.

useCases.title: Estimate the cost of an order and check the address
useCases.text: The AI estimates item prices, tax and shipping for SKUs sent to an address, and checks the address with a suggested correction. Nothing is ordered.

useCases.title: Find orders and their tracking numbers
useCases.text: The AI searches orders by name, email, postal code or date, and opens one with item status, tracking numbers and carriers.

useCases.title: Hold, cancel or resubmit an order, or cancel items
useCases.text: The AI sets an order to Hold or Cancelled, or re-submits a fixed order as New, or cancels single items before production. Cancelling cannot be undone.
